_doc: Grixis decks published with legality_status: pending (Bot cycle 38). Each entry lists the cards that are not yet Commander-legal and the date Scryfall gives for their set release. scripts/activate_pending_grixis.py refreshes the Scryfall bulk, re-checks these cards and sets status to active once every listed card is Commander-legal; validate_all fails a pending deck once legal_from has passed or its cards are already legal.

The_Madcap_Jester.note: The commander and Dragon's Smile come from Scryfall set `mbc` (draft_innovation), releasing 2026-10-19. Both are `not_legal` in Commander until then (Scryfall API and bulk, checked 2026-10-16). The source's 2026-10-15 approval keeps them under its registered *future-release* exceptions.

Tresserhorn_s_Lord__Returned.note: The commander is in Scryfall set `mbc`, releasing 2026-10-19, and is `not_legal` in Commander until then (Scryfall API and bulk, checked 2026-10-16). ⚠️ The source's 2026-10-15 approval record calls its earlier future-release exception "historical only" and reports "current official Commander legality PASS"; Scryfall does not agree yet.
